This is an unofficial LiteRT port of %1$s by Remigiusz Kinas, fine-tuned from Bielik (SpeakLeash and ACK Cyfronet AGH). The model is licensed under Apache-2.0.

The files come from huggingface.co/%2$s. Use Wi-Fi: the model is large.

The model picks among the options you give and says how sure it is. It does not know facts that are not in the state. Decisions with serious consequences for people need a review by a person.

basal LiteRT %1$s

An unofficial Android app for the basal-2.0 typed-decision models, run with Google LiteRT on the phone's GPU or CPU. Nothing you type leaves the phone.

Models: basal-2.0 by Remigiusz Kinas (github.com/rkinas/basal), Apache-2.0, fine-tuned from Bielik v3 (SpeakLeash, ACK Cyfronet AGH), Apache-2.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by their authors.

Runtime: LiteRT (Google), Apache-2.0. App: Jetpack Compose, AndroidX, Kotlin, Apache-2.0.

Source code and the conversion scripts: github.com/kgonia/basal-android
